summary_zh: 限定工程审核通过，生产完整板块尚未验收；继续原队列。
summary_en: Scoped engineering approved; no complete production block accepted; continue the existing queue.
sensitive_check_zh: 无凭据、邮箱或客户明细；仅固定聚合。
sensitive_check_en: No credentials, email addresses or customer records; fixed aggregates only.
limitations_zh: 真实Windows本地父子进程/崩溃锁验收通过；尚无多周期无人值守工程全链验收，POSIX未测。
limitations_en: Real local Windows child-process and crash-lock checks pass; no multi-cycle unattended engineering-chain acceptance, POSIX untested.
infrastructure_failure: Initial PowerShell host Out of memory; no result generated; excluded from test verdict. 首次宿主内存不足无结果，不计代码结果。

latest_followup.summary_zh: 实际执行晚于心跳标记；原预计时间已过、next_run已推进，但最近run未变。只证明调度与run需补证，不证明漏跑或业务入口原因。
latest_followup.summary_en: Execution is later than the trigger timestamp; the prior expected time passed and next_run advanced, while the latest run is unchanged. Scheduler/run reconciliation is needed; this alone proves neither a missed trigger nor the business-entry cause.
